name: @rawsql-ts/mcp-server
description: Six deterministic static SQL tools exposed as a local MCP server for rawsql-ts.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter rawsql-ts build && pnpm --filter @rawsql-ts/investigation-core build && pnpm --filter @rawsql-ts/sql-grep-core build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.release: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('../../tmp', { recursive: true })" && pnpm pack --out ../../tmp/rawsql-ts-mcp-server.tgz && pnpm publish --access public

author: msugiura
